data.change_summary: Normalized algae kinetics to use concentration-based (mg/L) half-saturation constants instead of legacy tank-total parameters. Renamed `algae_half_saturation_n_mg_total` → `algae_half_saturation_n_mg_n_per_l` (default 0.25 mg N/L) and `algae_half_saturation_p_mg_total` → `algae_half_saturation_p_mg_p_per_l` (default 0.04 mg P/L) across ProcessParams, ProcessParamsPreset, default.toml, and tank_scenarios. Removed `legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l` conversion from algae_growth.rs—parameters are now used directly as concentrations. Added comprehensive doc comments to `step_daily_algae` explaining light, nutrient (Monod/Liebig), and temperature (Gaussian) interactions, plus notes on what is intentionally abstracted for Phase 1. Added 5 new tests: tank-size independence with different geometries, hand-computed limitation factor verification, temperature sensitivity at one sigma, light-off biomass decline, and phosphorus limitation. All 8 baseline scenario envelopes pass unchanged.
outstanding_risks: Pre-existing test failure in snapshot_deserializes_legacy_chemistry_aliases (from concurrent tanksim-6e5.2.4 plant param migration, not caused by this change)
Pre-existing clippy warnings in snapshot.rs (unused serde imports) and water.rs (dead code) from concurrent changes — not introduced by this bead

Serde alias allows old field names to deserialize but the VALUE semantics changed (old: mg in 20L reference, new: mg/L). Saved states using old field names will be misinterpreted as mg/L values, producing very high half-saturation constants. This is acceptable in Phase 1 active development; production save migration would need explicit value conversion
Algae P cycle is intentionally not closed (documented in step_daily_algae comments). Model over-indexes on N limitation until P cycling is completed in a later phase

steps.description: Rename algae half-saturation fields in ProcessParams from legacy _mg_total to _mg_n_per_l / _mg_p_per_l with concentration-based defaults (0.25, 0.04) and serde aliases for backwards compatibility

Remove legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l conversion from algae_growth.rs; use ProcessParams concentration fields directly. Add doc comments documenting light × nutrient × temperature interactions and intentionally abstracted Phase 1 simplifications

Update ProcessParamsPreset in presets.rs: rename fields with serde aliases, update defaults to concentration values (0.25, 0.04), update provenance normalization from LegacyMgPerL to None, update field lookup keys and provenance list entries
Update default.toml field names and values from legacy totals (5.0, 0.8) to concentration (0.25, 0.04)
Update UNITS.md to mark algae renames as done (tanksim-6e5.2.5)
Add tank-size-independence test (algae_size_independence_different_geometries): two tanks with different fill heights but identical concentrations produce identical suspended-algae growth

Add hand-computed limitation product test (algae_growth_matches_hand_computed_limitation_product): verifies suspended biomass after one step matches expected value from light_factor × temp_factor × nutrient_factor × max_rate
Add temperature sensitivity test (algae_temperature_one_sigma_below_reduces_growth): gross growth ratio at T_opt − σ vs T_opt matches exp(−0.5)
Add light-off test (algae_light_off_causes_biomass_decline): disabled light → zero gross growth, biomass declines by exactly respiration fraction
Add phosphorus limitation test (algae_phosphorus_limits_growth_below_nitrogen_potential): P-depleted tank grows substantially less than P-rich tank with identical nitrogen

validation_evidence: cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration: 13/13 passed (including 5 new algae tests + 1 existing volume-invariance test + 7 existing plant tests)
cargo test -p tank_data: all tests passed (preset deserialization, provenance, validation)
cargo test -p tank_scenarios: 9/9 passed (scenario materialization with new param names)
cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_baseline_scenarios: 8/8 passed (nano_cycle, medium_planted, warm_room envelopes all within bounds — behaviour unchanged after normalization)
cargo build: clean compilation (only pre-existing warnings from concurrent snapshot.rs changes)
No nutrient limitation term references raw tank totals — algae_growth.rs uses ConcentrationView for nutrients and ProcessParams concentration fields for half-saturation constants directly
